{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Momentum and Volatility", 
"mechanism": "Combining momentum and volatility predictors captures the distinct return premia associated with each, as momentum exploits gradual information diffusion and volatility predictors capitalize on risk aversion.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Beta"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Value and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "The intersection of value and profitability predictors identifies high-quality firms at discounted prices, which are more likely to experience positive revisions in expectations and subsequent price appreciation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "OperProf"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Growth and Investment", 
"mechanism": "The combination of growth and investment predictors isolates firms with strong expansion potential and the ability to effectively allocate capital, leading to superior long-term performance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Momentum and Reversal", 
"mechanism": "The blend of momentum and reversal predictors balances the benefits of trending strategies with the mean-reversion properties of stock prices, resulting in more consistent returns across different market regimes.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "STreversal"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Quality and Yield", 
"mechanism": "The combination of quality and yield predictors focuses on firms with strong financials and attractive dividend yields, which are better positioned to weather economic downturns and provide stable returns.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "DivYieldST"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Size and Liquidity", 
"mechanism": "The intersection of size and liquidity predictors identifies smaller, more liquid firms that are more susceptible to information shocks and subsequent price movements.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Size"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Illiquidity"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Value and Momentum", 
"mechanism": "The combination of value and momentum predictors captures undervalued firms with strong price trends, which are more likely to experience continued price appreciation as their intrinsic value is recognized.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BMdec"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Growth and Volatility", 
"mechanism": "The blend of growth and volatility predictors isolates firms with high expansion potential and low risk, which are better positioned to deliver stable, long-term growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Beta"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30}
]}
